Body.Content:
Support for templated Kubernetes clusters is now in preview. This will simplify deployment and operations for Azure Stack users by allowing them to deploy the template to Azure or Azure Stack, thereby providing a consistent environment in each cloud. This update applies primarily to Azure Stack users.

Learn more about Kubernetes on Azure.

Azure Resource Manager templates.

Get more information about Azure Stack roles and responsibilities.
